parameter_semantics: No caller parameters. The policy's fixed intent is the assigned open_drawer responsibility. Two causal observations determine relational condition and the training-only phase prediction; the initial observation is duplicated only by the framework at episode start.
output_semantics: Each slot is an absolute world-frame TCP target: world position [3] in metres, world rotation as the first two matrix columns [6], and native gripper scalar [1]. Prediction slots are t-1..t+14 and execution uses slots 1..8 for t..t+7. Sampled 6D rotation is projected by Gram-Schmidt. The target is passed to panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured qpos, and the gripper scalar is appended unchanged for common sign-based execution. The phase label/head does not enter decode_action.

conversion_check.description: World position/6D rotation labels reconstruct each demonstrated commanded TCP pose; shared IK is independently checked by FK position/rotation and unchanged gripper scalar. Gram-Schmidt projects only sampled non-orthogonal values.

cut_relation: All actions in every assigned [0,470) segment are action-supervised. Auxiliary phase labels partition but do not trim the cut. Actions 230:470 remain full overlap with red_transfer across front release, retreat, red approach, closure and lift.
